title: Heptabase Updates - Mobile Voice Note and Whiteboard Journal Calendar
summary: Heptabase Updates - Mobile Voice Note and Whiteboard Journal Calendar
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


Over the past few weeks, we've fixed several data inconsistency issues. Some devices weren't showing complete data even when the sync indicator displayed "synced." If you've experienced this issue or encounter it in the future, please report it through our[in-app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156) !


---


### Mobile: Voice note quick capture​


In the latest version of our mobile app, you can take voice notes and transcribe them in real-time!


Currently, each user has a total transcription quota of 5 hours per month, allocated as follows:


1. Converting voice notes into transcripts: 3.5 hours
2. Generating transcripts from audio/video cards: 1.5 hours


Since transcription generation is a costly feature, we may adjust these quotas before the beta testing period concludes. Our goal is for Pro subscribers to access the full voice note transcription features without additional charges, while also offering upgraded plans or bring-your-own-API-key options for users who require higher transcription quotas.


---


### Whiteboard: Create a calendar for journal reviews​


In the latest version of our desktop app, you can create a calendar on your whiteboard using journal cards. You can now easily conduct weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews of your past journals with one click!


---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,


Heptabase Team
